Vilsk Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Vilsk was home to a Jewish agricultural colony in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, though very little is known about the colony or its cemetery. This record's category states the cemetery has not been built over, yet the site notes describe it as partly built over with a residential house — a tension worth flagging. The cemetery was demolished in the 1920s, according to KSEN, after which the land was plowed and, following WWII, a house was built on part of the site.
